expectation: The skin will become the body's protective outer covering.

reaction: The contrast between holding water in and releasing sweat was interesting.

mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the outer and deeper layers was worthwhile because it brought together the water-resistant barrier and the tissue supplying its living cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the gland and nerve endings was straightforward but a little repetitive once the named slots appeared.

surprise.text: The outer skin layer has no blood vessels of its own; its living cells receive supplies from deeper tissue.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and named slots made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: connecting the finished skin to the body showed how separate structures work together, and I would be curious to see another connection.
